Black Russian Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:55pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup Kahlua
1/4 cup Vodka optional
1 yellow cake mix
1 lg. pkg. instant chocolate pudding
4 eggs
1 cup oil
3/4 cup water

Preparation

1 Mix all together for 2 minutes. Pour into greased and floured angel food cake pan. Bake at 350 degree oven for 45 minutes or when toothpick comes out clean. 2 Cool completely before removing from pan. During cooling this moist cake does condense in size. Dust lightly with powdered sugar.
